description: Deprecated: use search. This name works until 2027-02-09. Find creators and businesses on Piku: photographers, guides, designers, studios, boutique hotels and more. Match by words (what they do, their niche, their Rates), a place (a city, a country name or code), a category, a language, or a point and a radius. kind picks creators, business or any (claimed pages first). Results show where each one is, whether the page is claimed, and when it last changed; unclaimed business pages have no prices and take no requests. Prices are starting prices in the page's currency; max_from_price is compared after converting currencies. Results are paged: pass next_cursor back as cursor.

category.description: Like hotel, boutique hotel, guesthouse, lodge, womenswear, beauty, bridal, studio, photographer

kind.description: Creators, businesses or both. Default any.

language.description: A language the page lists, like French

location.description: A city, a country name or code, or both, like Grand-Bassam, Cote d'Ivoire

near.description: Business pages within km (default 25) of a point

what.description: Words like wedding photographer, boutique hotel, code reviews
